transcript: Rocky Horror is taking over New York City. And for the Phantoms among us, this is our moment. Right now at the Charlie Palmer Apry Bar inside the Luma Hotel, once a week, they're doing a Rocky Horror Drag bingo. That is the kind of chaotic joy I need in my. Hosted by Frida Cox, who brings the energy, serves live performances, makes plenty of Rocky Horror theme jokes, but still keeps it fun for the whole family. There were so many kids having the time of their life. Each round has incredible prizes, and you can even win tickets to see Rocky Horror on Broadway. They also have themed food and drinks, including a special deal where you can get a Time Warp cocktail and an app. And for under $30, the Midtown is unheard of. We also had to try the creature feature pie, which was so good. And the best part is the bingo itself is free, so you can just grab some friends and make a whole night of it, which is exactly what we did before going to see The Rocky Horror Show on Broadway. Now, I've loved Rocky Horror since I was a teenager, but I've never gotten to see it live on stage, and I was so blown away from the minute I walked into Studio 54 because they have gone all out with this theatre. It's incredibly atmospheric and vibey. The energy from the crowd was electric. People came in full costume and I absolutely loved this production. Sam Pinkleton directs it so well. It's big and can't be and theatrical, and you never know what's going to happen next, even if you know the show as well as I do. And the cast is exceptional. I love Amber Gray and her riff raff my life. I'm obsessed with Stephanie. She's Janet. Her comedic timing is next level. Luke Evans is giving one of my favourite performances of the entire season. You just have to see him. Anyway, if you're looking for a way to celebrate Rocky Horror's return to New York, this is the way to do it.
reasoning: Creator saw the show and strongly recommends it, praising direction, atmosphere, and multiple cast members with enthusiastic language like 'absolutely loved' and 'one of my favorite performances of the entire season.'
